entities.name: Leandro García Morales
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leandro García Morales is a Uruguayan-Italian former professional basketball player and current head coach. At a height 1.88 m tall, he played at the shooting guard position. He was also a member of the senior Uruguayan national basketball team. He currently coaches for Astros de Jalisco.
